_: ⭐ THE WORDS `formulaHints.js` SAYS BESIDE A REFUSED FORMULA. Data, not code, for the same reason `preflightRules.json` is: a module that hand-lists four or more indicator names is an enumeration site (`enumerationSites.test.js`), and this table names dozens. Every `instead` is the idiom the matching ruling in `closedTable.json::_functions_excluded` names; every spelling maps a name another platform uses onto a function this table already declares. `formulaHints.test.js` evaluates every concrete formula below at the formula sheet, so a suggestion that stops working fails by name.

variance.why: the square of the population standard deviation

obv.why: an all-history running total depends on how much history is loaded, so it is bounded to the last n bars

pvt.why: bounded to the last n bars, for the same reason as OBV

spellings.tr: max(high - low, max(abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1])))
spellings.truerange: max(high - low, max(abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1])))

change.say: `change(x)` is the one-bar change. For n bars write `close - close[5]` (or `mom(close, 5)`)

macd.say: `macd(close, 12, 26)` is the MACD line; its 9-bar signal is `ema(macd(close, 12, 26), 9)`
